factors: Eight material claims across source assertions, research and editorial inference
complexity.rationale: The 12:02 source is short, but eight claims and the proposed authority/retrieval experiment require extended mapping, counterargument and tradeoff review.

sourceMap.rationale: Machine ASR separately reports inference-time and vector database/embedding maintenance-cost nine-tenths reductions; neither is independently measured here.
The video names BM25 at this passage. The separate BEIR published abstract supports the research finding about a robust baseline; video speech is not evidence of the paper result.

The presenter dismisses RAG at this later passage after defining it more broadly near the beginning. The article distinguishes lexical retrieval from the wider architecture, without claiming a benchmark.
The source product-price example motivates a recency boost; the article separately tests whether newer records necessarily carry authority.
The proposed pipeline retains original material, likely-query summaries and technical atoms, with summary matches pointing to raw data.
The source reports tens of thousands of records across development history, model sessions and transcripts; creator metadata supplies Engram spelling.
The presenter describes context-rot, cost and latency concerns; the cited long-context study supplies bounded research context, not an Engram benchmark.

sourceCoverage.rationale: A verified private pack and 153 timed machine-ASR cues cover the 12:02 source span; source and cue hashes were independently checked. ASR text was reviewed without asserting listening, visual or quotation accuracy.

supportingArgument.rationale: The complete 146-block manuscript develops practical lexical retrieval, source retention, memory qualification and authority continuity, with no mechanical compression.

evidenceRoles.rationale: Two source-reported percentage measures remain unverified and separate. BEIR and long-context research are bounded context; hypothetical approval failures and the GhostMesh test are original analysis, not observations.

counterargument.rationale: The article recognizes that more complex ranking can outperform BM25 and admits semantic/hybrid retrieval when measured misses justify it. It preserves the value of the source design and its existing raw-data backlinks.

tradeoffs.rationale: Context cost and latency are weighed against retrieval quality, stale recency, omitted qualifications and the extra burden of indexing or control machinery.

falsifiability.rationale: The proposed comparison holds corpus and answer model fixed and uses adjudicated historical questions, authority state, qualifications, missing evidence, latency and cost. No such experiment was run.

originalSynthesis.rationale: The distinct conclusion is that retrieval improves recall while decisions require preserved status, provenance, qualifications and supersession; cheaper or newer text is not automatically governing knowledge.

performance.rationale: Reported inference-time and vector-database/embedding-cost reductions have no independently audited baseline, denominator or quality control. Published research is not an Engram performance replication.

economics.rationale: The questions explicitly include model choice, context amount, retrieval versus total latency, ingestion/storage costs and preserved quality; no general 90-percent savings promise is made.

threatGovernance.rationale: The article preserves Development-versus-Production qualifications and separates proposals, approvals and observed effects. Examples are hypothetical; no unauthorized Engram action or deployed GhostMesh control is claimed.

ownerDecision.approval: Tony approved the complete manuscript and the exact source-title/provenance and two denominator amendments, then all five editorial relationships and mechanical canonical-wrapper implementation in one draft PR/public Netlify preview. The independent implementation review accepts the unchanged copy and approved connections. This retains the actual conversational authorization, not cryptographic authentication; visual UAT, mark-ready, exact-head merge and Production remain held.

gaps.rationale: Machine ASR has not been listening-checked. No visual demonstration or numerical performance result is independently verified; source-attributed paraphrase and explicit limitations are retained.

decisionRationale: Actual fresh independent source/editorial/privacy implementation review accepts these exact authored HTML and source-map bytes after the precise-cue correction. Owner decisions cover only the recorded copy, five editorial relationships and the draft-preview workflow; no ready, merge, automerge or Production authority.
